# Tauhid Shekhar - Full Stack Software Engineer & Creator

> Professional portfolio, software engineering case studies, full-stack web applications, and developer community led by Tauhid Shekhar.

## Overview
Tauhid Shekhar is a Full Stack MERN Developer, Software Engineer, and UI/UX Designer specializing in building scalable web applications, performant RESTful APIs, and responsive digital products using React.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Tailwind CSS.

## Core Competencies & Skills
- Frontend: React.js, Next.js, Redux Toolkit, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Responsive UI/UX.

- Tooling & Practices: Git, GitHub, Vite, Postman, Vercel, Render, Web Performance, Core Web Vitals, Technical SEO, W3C Accessibility (WCAG 2.1).
